name: visitojs
description: Device identification in the browser: a stored id, a fingerprint id and flags for what could not be read. No network requests; core under 8 KB.
author: VisitoJS

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['build','dist'])for(const f of fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d):[])fs.rmSync(d+'/'+f,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.bundle: rollup -c && terser dist/visito.js --ecma 5 --safari10 -c hoist_funs=true,passes=2,inline=1,pure_getters=false -m --comments -o dist/visito.min.js && terser dist/visito.defer.js --ecma 5 --safari10 -c hoist_funs=true,passes=2,inline=1,pure_getters=false -m --comments -o dist/visito.defer.min.js && terser dist/visito.lab.js --ecma 5 --safari10 -c hoist_funs=true,passes=2,inline=1,pure_getters=false -m --comments -o dist/visito.lab.min.js && terser dist/deep.js --ecma 5 --safari10 -c hoist_funs=true,passes=2,inline=1,pure_getters=false -m --comments -o dist/deep.min.js
scripts.check: es-check es5 dist/visito.js dist/visito.min.js dist/visito.defer.js dist/visito.defer.min.js dist/visito.lab.js dist/visito.lab.min.js dist/deep.js dist/deep.min.js && es-check es5 --module dist/visito.esm.js dist/visito.defer.esm.js dist/match.js dist/deep.esm.js && tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle && npm run check
